required_input_values.equals: Preserve the two operators, their identity, clothing, chairs, console layout, and the exact warm teal-and-amber control room from the starting image. One uninterrupted 3.75-second cinematic shot. The camera makes a smooth shallow arc to the right. An existing amber console status light begins blinking; the nearer operator quickly leans forward and presses one console button while the other operator turns to watch the central monitor. The display gives a subtle moving signal sweep and nearby indicator lights respond. Keep faces, bodies, furniture, and room geometry stable; no cuts, no new objects, no warped hands, and no text changes. Generate only synchronized room tone, a relay click, soft electrical hum, ventilation, and a gentle static tick. No dialogue, speech, voices, vocals, humming, or music.
